description: Defines data structures, enums, and constants related to positioning, measurement, and configuration in a 5G NR RAN context, including geographical positioning, SSB properties, timing, and signal references.

classes.name: ssb_burst_position_t
classes.description: Represents the position of an SSB burst with a bitmap and type.

classes.name: ng_ran_access_point_position_t
classes.description: Represents the geographical position of a cell/TP antenna, including latitude, longitude, altitude, and confidence.

classes.name: ssb_t
classes.description: Represents an SSB with PCI number and optional index.

classes.name: time_stamp_slot_idx_t
classes.description: Represents a time slot index with type and value.

classes.name: time_stamp_t
classes.description: Represents a timestamp with system frame number, slot index, and optional measurement time.

classes.name: dl_prs_t
classes.description: Represents a downlink PRS with identifiers and comparison operators.

classes.name: spatial_relation_info_t
classes.description: Contains reference signals related to spatial relations, using variants for different signal types.

classes.name: active_ul_bwp_t
classes.description: Represents active uplink bandwidth part configuration including subcarrier spacing, prefix, and SRS config.

classes.name: srs_carrier_list_item_t
classes.description: Details a carrier with point A, bandwidth, active BWP, and optional PCI.

classes.name: srs_configuration_t
classes.description: Holds a list of SRS carrier configurations.

classes.name: trp_tx_teg_info_t
classes.description: Contains information about TRP transmission timing error margin and ID.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for various structs, comparing all relevant fields.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality operator for various structs, based on equality operator.
